Name: Adorable Penguin Plushies (AT or DGA)
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:
Adorable Penguin Plushies, 3 sizes available, 8 colour variants for each.

Available in two versions:

[b][u]AT Version [b][b][u](For 1.6 and 1.5.6)[/u][/b][/b]:[/u][/b]

1) Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures.[/url]
2) Use the [b]Paint Bucket[/b] to change the textures of the following vanilla furniture to the penguin plushies:
[list]
[*][b]Lg. Futan Bear[/b]
[*][b]Futan Bear[/b]
[*][b]House Plant[/b]
[/list][b]
[b][u]DGA/AT Version (For 1.5.6):[/u][/b]

[/b]1) Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures.[/url]﻿
2) Get the penguin plushies from the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b].
3) Use the [b]Paint Bucket[/b] to change the color of the penguin plushies:
